```{r}
#| label: metrics
#| include: false
# Build-time proof of work. Grand totals, frozen by `freeze: auto`, refreshed
# monthly by GitHub Actions. Falls back to a static string when cranlogs is
# unreachable or the package is not installed - never fabricates a number.
fmt_dls <- function(n) {
  if (is.na(n)) return("2.8M+")
  if (n >= 1e6) paste0(round(n / 1e6, 1), "M+")
  else paste0(format(round(n / 1e3), big.mark = ","), "K+")
}

pkgs <- c("olsrr", "xplorerr", "rfm", "descriptr", "rbin", "blorr",
          "vistributions", "inferr", "yahoofinancer", "nse2r", "standby")

total_dls <- tryCatch({
  if (!requireNamespace("cranlogs", quietly = TRUE)) stop("cranlogs not installed")
  res <- cranlogs::cran_downloads(packages = pkgs, from = "2017-01-01",
                                  to = as.Date(Sys.Date()))
  sum(res$count, na.rm = TRUE)
}, error = function(e) NA_real_)

downloads <- fmt_dls(total_dls)
n_pkgs <- length(pkgs)
n_books <- 6L
```

I build statistical software that holds up outside a tutorial, and I help
teams do the same. Author of 11 R packages with 2.8M+ CRAN downloads and 6
open textbooks. Founder of [Rsquared Academy](https://www.rsquaredacademy.com/),
an open-source education platform for data science.

I earned my postgraduate degree from
[Madras School of Economics](https://www.mse.ac.in/) (Anna University),
Chennai. Most of my work sits at the intersection of R, statistics,
economics and finance. Previously I built tooling at
[Rsquared Computing](https://www.rsquaredacademy.com/); I now maintain my own
package portfolio independently. Based in Bengaluru, India.

## Open Source {#open-source}

Ten actively maintained CRAN packages, 2.8M+ combined downloads.

| Package | What it does | CRAN downloads |
|:--------|:-------------|----------------:|
| [olsrr](https://olsrr.rsquaredacademy.com) | Tools for building and interpreting OLS regression models | 1.09M |
| [xplorerr](https://xplorerr.rsquaredacademy.com) | Interactive data exploration, visualization and modeling | 676K |
| [rfm](https://rfm.rsquaredacademy.com) | Recency, frequency and monetary value analysis for customer segmentation | 441K |
| [descriptr](https://descriptr.rsquaredacademy.com) | Fast descriptive statistics and frequency tables for R | 166K |
| [rbin](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/rbin) | Bin and group numeric data into intervals | 163K |
| [blorr](https://blorr.rsquaredacademy.com) | Tools for developing binary logistic regression models | 105K |
| [vistributions](https://vistributions.rsquaredacademy.com) | Visualize probability distributions of univariate data | 60K |
| [inferr](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com) | Hypothesis testing and inference for R | 57K |
| [yahoofinancer](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/yahoofinancer) | Fetch financial data from Yahoo! Finance | 30K |
| [standby](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/standby) | Manage R processes and sessions | 16K |

See [Packages](packages/) for documentation and vignettes for each one.

## Consulting & Advisory

**Model validation and econometric audits.** Independent review of
specification, identification and inference. You get a written report, not
just a fixed script.

**Custom package development and architecture.** Internal R or Python tooling
built to survive handover: documented, tested, and structured so your team can
extend it without me.

**Team masterclasses.** Tidyverse, SQL, command-line tooling. Hands-on
sessions built around your own data and problems.

**Who this is for:** teams shipping quantitative work that other people have
to maintain. **Who it is not for:** one-off analyses, or anyone looking for a
pre-packaged answer.
